pkgmetadata.longdescription: The rustc-dev component of the Rust toolchain: the compiler's own crates (rustc_driver, rustc_interface, ...), needed to build rustc drivers such as dev-util/crubit. Installed from the tarball that dev-lang/rust builds with USE=dist, into that Rust slot's sysroot, like "rustup component add rustc-dev" does. Slotted per Rust slot.
